metadata.title: European Basketball Coaches from Wikipedia
metadata.scope: Country-by-team English Wikipedia categories associated with European domestic, regional and continental basketball leagues.
metadata.ratingExplanation: Head-coach honors receive full competition-specific value. Assistant, consultant and youth honors receive reduced value. Player achievements remain in the database but receive zero coaching points. Experience is added and raw scores are percentile-ranked across the scraped European pool. The 99th percentile and above is capped at 90.

coaches.name: Derya Yannier
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Turkey by team

biography.introduction: Derya Yannier (born 28 February 1985) is a Turkish Jewish former professional basketball player. His father, Habib Yannier, was also a professional player who represented the Turkey men's national basketball team in the Olympics.

coaches.name: Andaç Yapıcıer
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Turkey by team

biography.introduction: Andaç Yapıcıer (born 18 December 1984) is a Turkish professional basketball coach, who is currently the head coach of Qadsia SC of the Kuwaiti Basketball League and assistant coach of Qatar National Team.

coaches.name: Hakan Yavuz
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Turkey by team

biography.introduction: Hakan Yavuz (born 1 June[citation needed] 1960 in Istanbul, Turkey) is a Turkish professional basketball coach, who was signed by Denizli Basket in 2015 and by Yalovaspor Basketbol in 2024.

orderedInfoboxRows.html: • 2x Turkish Second Basketball League champion

coaches.name: Stanislav Yeryomin
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Russia by team

biography.introduction: Stanislav Georgiyevich Yeryomin (Russian: Станислав Георгиевич Ерёмин; born February 26, 1951 in Sverdlovsk, Soviet Union), last name also spelled Eremin and Yeremin, is a retired Russian professional basketball player and coach. During his playing career, at a height of 1.81 m (5'11 .mw-parser-output .frac{white-space:nowrap}.mw-parser-output .frac .num,.mw-parser-output .frac .den{font-size:80%;line-height:0;vertical-align:super}.mw-parser-output .frac .den{vertical-align:sub}.mw-parser-output .sr-only{border:0;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);clip-path:polygon(0px 0px,0px 0px,0px 0px);height:1px;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;padding:0;position:absolute;width:1px}1⁄4") tall, he played at the point guard position. He is also a retired Russian Army Colonel.

coaches.name: Ceyhun Yıldızoğlu
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Turkey by team

biography.introduction: Ceyhun Yıldızoğlu (born 6 March 1967) is a Turkish professional basketball coach. He is currently coaching the Turkish pro side Çukurova Basketbol.
